title: スーツおじさんが、発車寸前の満員電車にギリギリで乗り込み出発するまでを、映画ジョンウィックのような激しいアクションで動画にして
content: スーツおじさんが、発車寸前の満員電車にギリギリで乗り込み出発するまでを、映画ジョンウィックのような激しいアクションで動画にして

en.content:
Make a video of a suit-wearing middle-aged man barely squeezing onto a packed train just before departure, with intense action in the style of the movie John Wick.

--- QUOTED TWEET ---
Can it really be this easy to create an action scene? lol  
Seedance 2.5 is terrifying 🎬✨  
Here’s the prompt, by the way? 👇                                                                                                                                                                                                                    

【Make a video of a suit-wearing middle-aged man barely squeezing onto a packed train just before departure, with intense action in the style of the movie John Wick.】

That’s all.  
I only used the old man’s character sheet as a reference...  
I didn’t specify any action choreography at all.

If you’re not too particular about the content, it means you can make as much material as you want for AI video affiliate use ✨
